vaultScouting.evaluation: Williams is a compact 5-11 / 185 corner. On the Jacksonville (NC) sophomore sit he undercuts the out for a pick-six, forces a fumble downhill, and chases down a breakaway. He will guess the short throw.
vaultScouting.comparison: Williams comps to Trent McDuffie — 5-11 / 193 compact press/man corner with twitch, physicality, and the same downhill strike.
vaultScouting.projection: Williams projects as a Year 1 special-teams / nickel corner, then a Year 2 rotation piece, with Year 3 starter upside if he stays in phase on the double move.
strengths: Williams undercuts the quick out, takes the interception in stride, and scores.
Williams triggers downhill, squares the runner, and forces the fumble.
Williams chases from the backside and saves the touchdown with closing speed.
Williams gets his head around on the vertical and plays the ball instead of the back.
vaultScouting.schemeFit: Williams fits a physical perimeter CB who can jump the short throw and still run the vertical.
